requirements: R1: Patch the synchronization logic to correctly map a GitHub PR closure without merge to an internal failed state instead of done

slices.title: Patch PR closure synchronization status
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization patch for this epic, I want to map unmerged GitHub PR closures to a failed state, so that the internal task status correctly reflects the GitHub state without falsely marking tasks as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task linked to a GitHub PR,
When the GitHub PR is closed without being merged,
Then the internal task status transitions to a failed or open state rather than 'done'.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' task statuses from current baseline to 0

epics.title: Unblock Flow Core from Failed Frontier
epics.jtbd: When the project progress is halted at a failed frontier, I want to clear or retry the failed tasks, so that the flow core can resume processing active work.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Flow Core idle time due to failed frontier from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Patch the Flow Core engine to unblock progress from the 'BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER' state caused by failed tasks

slices.title: Patch Flow Core to unblock failed frontier
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery for this epic, I want to clear the blocked state, so that active work can resume in the flow core.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Flow Core is in 'BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER' state,
When the unblocking patch is executed,
Then the blocking failed tasks are handled and the state transitions to active.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase system movement in recent cycles from 0% to greater than 0%
